artwork.title: Fountain figure
artwork.note: Catalogue dimensions are sculpture envelope dimensions, not pool measurements or a survey of placement. Simplified reclining pose is reconstructed from the full displayed university photograph. No photograph pixels are redistributed.

photographs.observation: Full displayed official context inspected: enclosed brick lawn court, flowering jacaranda, low shrubs, paved margins, shallow pool / figure and low foreground edge. Date and exact current condition unverified.

Full displayed 700 px photograph inspected: dark reclining copper figure, propped elbow, raised shell hand, shallow bronze dish, pale irregular pool coping and water. Fine anatomy / unseen back and exact hydraulic operation are not reproduced.

aerial.observation: Native aerial enlarged once: eastern court labelled Chancellor’s Garden, irregular small fountain / coping north of the central lawn, side planting and north access. No internal walking Street View coverage visible. Google Images query UNSW Chancellor’s Garden Old Main sculpture inspected; strongest result is the university artwork photograph.
